_comment: DESIGN TOKENS. The developer changes the entire look and motion of the site from this one file — colours, type, spacing, corners, shadows, animation. No content file and no page template needs editing to restyle the site.
_how_it_works: The build emits every token below as a CSS custom property on :root (--color-accent, --motion-duration-base, and so on). Templates reference ONLY the variables, never raw hex or px values. Change a token here, rebuild, and every page changes together.
_rule: If a developer has to open a page template to change a colour, spacing value or animation, that template is wrong. Fix the template, not the token.

color._comment: Semantic names, not colour names. 'accent-price' can become blue without the variable name lying.
_contrast_rules: accent-price (#C8451F) is 4.49:1 on ground — LARGE TEXT ONLY, 24px and above. For small text use accent-price-text (#B03A18, 5.67:1).
ink-faint on ground is the lightest text permitted. Never go lighter for body copy.
Any new colour must be checked at 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 at 24px+, before it enters this file.

typography._comment: Two families. Swapping either one restyles the site — keep the roles, change the faces.
typography._self_host_note: Self-host both before launch. A Google Fonts request is a render-blocking third-party call and it is the easiest 200ms you will ever save.
typography._mobile_note: Display sizes multiply by this on screens under 640px. Body sizes do NOT scale down — 16px is the floor, and 15px is the absolute minimum anywhere on the site.

space._comment: 4px base. Use the scale; never type an arbitrary px value into a template.

shadow._comment: Used sparingly. Borders carry most of the separation in this design — if you want a more elevated look, raise these and drop the borders.

motion._comment: ALL animation is configured here. A developer changes the feel of the whole site by editing this block — no keyframes are written inline in a template.

level._comment: One switch sets how animated the whole site is. Ship at 'subtle'. Raise it only if it demonstrably does not cost LCP or INP.

options.none: No animation beyond instant state changes. The accessibility fallback and the performance floor.
options.subtle: Hover and focus transitions, fade-and-rise on section entry, counters animate once. RECOMMENDED.
options.expressive: Adds staggered card entry, parallax on the hero panel, animated number counters on every stat.

rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — drop to level 'none'. Not optional.
Never animate anything above the fold on first paint. It costs LCP and your buyer is on 4G.
Never animate width, height, top or left. transform and opacity only.
Entry animations run ONCE. A section that re-animates every scroll is nausea, not polish.
No animation may delay a CTA becoming tappable.

proof_slot._comment: How an unfilled proof slot renders. See PROOF-SYSTEM.md.

production._note: An EMPTY slot renders NOTHING in production — no blank box, no 'coming soon'. The section reflows as if the slot were not there. A section whose slots are all EMPTY hides entirely.
